source: 755 Different Attitudes
target: 755 Diversae Attitudines

source: 755 Different Attitudes
target: 755 Diversae Attitudines

source: Despite Madame Hela’s usual restraint and calm, there are clear emotional ripples this time…
target: Quamquam domina Hela solitam moderationem et tranquillitatem exerceat, hoc tempore evidentes tamen fluctus affectuum apparent…

source: Franca thoughtfully withdrew her gaze.
target: Franca, ratiocinandis, oculos suos avertit.

source: By then, many members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society had regained their composure from the shock, voicing their opinions with both excitement and urgency.
target: Iam multi ex membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis post stuporem suam aequabilitatem restituerunt, opinionesque suas simul cum excitamento et urgenza proferentes ediderunt.

source: Someone shouted, “Hidden Blade, you can’t make such assumptions so lightly!”
target: Quidam exclamavit: “Lamina Occulta, tales coniecturas tam leviter facere non potes!”

source: Franca roared back immediately, “Whether or not Resurrection Island is a nexus between two worlds, we still need to find Harrison! This isn’t a conclusion; it’s a direction for our investigation!”
target: Franca statim replicavit rugiens: “Sive Insula Resurrectionis nexus sit inter duos mundos sive non, adhuc Harrison reperire necesse est! Hoc non est conclusio; sed directio inquisitionis nostrae!”

source: Another person yelled, “How can we find someone just based on a name?”
target: Alia persona exclamavit: “Quomodo aliquem tantum ex nomine invenire possumus?”

source: “I have his portrait!” Franca responded instantly.
target: “Eum imaginem habeo!” Franca statim respondit.

source: As members expressed their expectations, posed questions, and sought answers, a voice, slightly out of control, shouted, “Why can’t you just live peacefully in the present?”
target: Dum membra suas exspectationes exprimebant, quaestiones proponebant, responsa quaerebant, vox, paulo perturbata, exclamavit: “Cur in praesenti tranquilliter vivere non potestis?”

source: Franca looked towards the source of the sound and saw a male member known as Mole.
target: Franca ad fontem soni respexit et virum membrum, qui Mole nominabatur, vidit.

source: After Mole spoke up, several members loudly said, “I don’t want to risk everything for a slim hope.”
target: Postquam Mole locutus est, plures membra alta voce dixerunt: “Nolo omnia pro tenuissima spe periclitari.”

source: “Why can’t you give up these fantasies?”
target: “Cur has phantasiās relinquere non potestis?”

source: “I have no interest in returning to our previous world!”
target: “Non cupio redire ad mundum nostrum priorem!”

source: In response to the dissenting voices, Franca wasn’t surprised but internally sighed, People vary so much when you gather a hundred of them…
target: Ad voces dissentientes Franca non mirata est, sed interius suspiravit: “Homines tam varii sunt, cum centum congregentur…”

source: She sincerely responded, “Searching for Harrison and verifying the situation on Resurrection Island are both entirely voluntary. Those who want to uncover the truth about our transmigration can decide if it’s worth the risk. Those who aren’t interested can continue as before, but please don’t stop others from participating.”
target: Sincere respondit: “Inquisitio ad Harrison quaerendum et status in Insula Resurrectionis perscrutatio omnino voluntaria sunt. Qui veritatem de nostra transmigratione detegere volunt, possunt decernere an periculum id referat. Qui non student, ut antea pergere possunt—sed quaeso, alios a participatione non prohibeatis.”

source: Mole and others were clearly still worried that investigating Resurrection Island might disrupt their current lives, but with Franca offering the choice of “free will,” they could only mutter and retreat to the fringes.
target: Mole et ceteri manifeste solliciti erant ne investigatio Insulae Resurrectionis vitam eorum praesentem perturbaret, sed cum Franca optionem “liberae voluntatis” offerret, solum murmure reticere ac ad latera recedere poterant.

source: Seizing the opportunity, Franca added, “For now, our investigation into Resurrection Island is limited to gathering information. Do not go looking for it—it’s very dangerous. Once we obtain key information from Harrison, we’ll discuss whether or not to go to the island and how to approach it. Right now, let me show you Harrison’s portrait.”
target: Occasione capta, Franca addidit: “Ad hoc tempus, nostra investigatio in Insulam Resurrectionis ad informationes colligendas tantum restringitur. Nolite eam quaerere—periculosissima enim est. Quam informationem clavis a Harrison obtineamus, de insula eundum atque de modo accessus rem disputabimus. Nunc, sinite me imaginem Harrisonis vobis ostendere.”

source: Cheers erupted from some of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society members who had grasped the situation: “Hidden Blade is awesome!”
target: Alii ex membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis, qui rem intellexerant, exclamaverunt: “Lamina Occulta praeclara est!”

source: “Hidden Blade, I love you!”
target: “Lamina Occulta, te amo!”

source: “Praise be to Hidden Blade!”
target: “Laudetur Lamina Occulta!”

source: Franca chuckled and tilted her head, her worries and fears somewhat alleviated by the emotions of the crowd.
target: Franca subridentem risit et caput inclinavit; sollicitationes et timores eius paulo levati erant per affectus turbae.

source: She knew that these members were not without fear of the unknown results of the investigation and the potentially disappointing truths it might reveal, but they had waited too long and desired too much. Even a small glimmer of hope could temporarily relieve their pain and sorrow, releasing their excitement and joy.
target: Sciebat hos membra non carere timore eventuum ignotorum inquisitionis atque veritatum fortasse deludentium, sed nimis diu exspectaverant atque nimis desideraverant. Etiam parva scintilla spei levare posset transitori dolore atque tristitia, excitamentum et gaudium eorum fovere.

source: Franca then took a deep breath, pulled out Harrison’s portrait, and affixed it to the back of the massive stone chair.
target: Franca deinde alte anhelavit, picturam Harrisonis extraxit, eamque ad tergum magnae sellae lapideae adfixit.

source: “Everyone, take turns to come and take a look!” Franca called out, stepping back from the area around the speckled stone chair.
target: “Omnes, vicissim venite et intuite!” Franca exclamavit, recedens a zona circa sellae lapideae maculatae.

source: “Do you really think that’s a nexus between two worlds?” Gandalf stopped Franca, asking fervently.
target: “Putatisne vere hoc esse nexum inter duos mundos?” Gandalf Francam sistens fervide rogavit.

source: Franca smiled awkwardly. “It’s just a theory, still.”
target: Franca ineleganter subridens respondit: “Modo theoria est, adhuc.”

source: Gandalf nodded with satisfaction.
target: Gandalf cum satisfactione caput inclinavit.

source: “That’s no problem. Make bold assumptions, but verify them carefully.”
target: “Nulla quaestio est. Coniecturas audaces facite, sed ea diligenter comprobate.”

source: “What, in your opinion, is the relationship between Resurrection Island and our world?”
target: “Quid, in tua sententia, est relatio inter Insulam Resurrectionis et mundum nostrum?”

source: Franca asked Gandalf, both hopeful and nervous.
target: Franca Gandalfum rogavit, spe et timore simul affecta.

source: Gandalf chuckled. “I don’t have any predetermined conclusions yet; I need more information to study.”
target: Gandalf ridente dixit: “Nullas conclusiones praefixas adhuc habeo; mihi plura ad studendum necessaria sunt.”

source: Franca glanced around and lowered her voice.
target: Franca circumspexit et vocem deiecit.

source: She shared the existence of the Samaritan Women’s Spring, Underworld Daoist, and Celestial Master with President Gandalf, whom she and Lumian had decided to inform before attending this meeting—previously, they had only shared this with Hela. After all, they had worked together in the real world before.
target: Ea de existentia Fontis Mulierum Samaritarum, Daoista Inferorum, et Magistri Caelestis cum Praeside Gandalf, quem illa et Lumian ante hanc conventum certiorem facere statuerant (ordinario modo hoc tum modo tantum cum Hela communicaverant), communicavit; quippe, olim in mundo reali una laboraverant.

source: Gandalf listened attentively and made a judgment.
target: Gandalf attente auscultavit et iudicium dedit.

source: “The relationship between the two worlds might be closer than we anticipated.
target: “Relatio inter hos duos mundos fortasse propius est quam putaveramus.

source: “The phenomenon of transmigration may have started even earlier.”
target: Phænomenon transmigrationis fortasse etiam prius inchoatum fuit.”

source: Before Hidden Blade Franca could respond, the president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society mused to himself, “With so many signs and traces, it’s incredible we haven’t encountered them, while you frequently do.”
target: Antequam Franca, quae Lamina Occulta appellatur, responderet, Praeses Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis sibi meditatus est: “Cum tot signa et vestigia adsint, incredibile est quod eos non occurramus, dum vos eos frequenter invenitis.”

source: This probably requires your praise for the True Creator.. Franca barely held back a sarcastic remark.
target: Fortasse hoc exigit tuam laudem pro Vero Creatore… Franca vix retinuit rem sarcasticam.

source: After parting from the half-giant Gandalf, she was cornered by the tall 007.
target: Postquam ab semi-gigante Gandalf discessit, 007 altus eam in angulum conduxit.

source: “We’ve yet to find the person who might be Harrison,” 007 simply reported on the previous “person-finding” efforts.
target: “Nondum invenimus personam quae Harrison esse posset,” 007 de praeteritis conatibus inveniendi simpliciter nuntiavit.

source: “Maybe he’s no longer in Trier.” Franca refrained from complaining about the Purifiers’ inefficiency.
target: “Forsitan iam non in Trier sit.” Franca querelas de inefficientia Purificatorum abstinuit.

source: She glanced at “007” in lion headgear and cautiously asked, “Would you want to return to our original world?”
target: Aspicit “007” galeam leonis gerentem, et caute rogavit: “Visne ad mundum nostrum originarium redire?”

source: 007 paused for a few seconds before replying, “Of course, but I’m afraid everything has changed.”
target: 007 paucos secundos stetit antequam respondit: “Certe, sed timeo omnia mutata esse.”

source: “Although the era from which Emperor Roselle transmigrated isn’t far from ours—if we returned now, we’d only miss a few days of life—no one has gone back yet, so we can’t be certain. Maybe the rules for coming and going are fundamentally different.”
target: “Quamquam aetas ex qua Imperator Roselle transmigravit non longe a nostra est—si nunc redire mussemus, tantum paucos dies vitae amitteremus—nemo adhuc rediit, itaque certi esse non possumus. Forsitan regulæ ad ingressum et ad exitum fundamentaliter diversa sint.”

source: Franca fell silent.
target: Franca siluit.

source: 007 glanced at Gandalf sitting on the steps, scribbling in a notebook, and asked Franca, “What did you discuss with the president? He seemed quite stirred.”
target: 007 respexit ad Gandalf sedente in scalis, notis scribentem in schedula, et Francam rogavit: “Quid cum praeside disputavisti? Videbatur enim valde commotus esse.”

source: Franca, managing her emotions, took the opportunity to share with 007 what she had told Gandalf.
target: Franca, sensus suos moderans, occasionem cepit ut 007 narrarent ea quae ad Gandalf dixerat.

source: “‘007’ Angoulême was stunned for a moment, then clenched his teeth and said, ‘Why didn’t you share this information sooner? What else haven’t you told us?’”
target: “‘007’ Angoulême per momentum obstupefactus est, deinde dentes contraxit et dixit: ‘Cur has informationes non antea divulgavisti? Quid aliud nobis nondum narravisti?’”

source: “I was just afraid you would really go all 007?” Franca joked, only to be met by a stern look from 007, which made her chuckle awkwardly. “Sometimes, it’s not that I don’t want to share; it’s either not the right time or I don’t have the permission.”
target: “’Timui modo ne vere vos totum 007 ageretis?’ Franca iocata est, sed 007 vultum severum ostendens eam ineleganter subridere provocavit. ‘Non est quod nolo communicare; interdum tempus non idoneum est aut licentiam non habeo.’”

source: I’m not Lumian, who has to squeeze out information like toothpaste—if I could tell, I would share everything… Franca added in her mind.
target: “Non sum Lumian, qui notitias quasi pastae dentifrici exprimere debeat; si possem, omnia communicarem…” Franca in mente sua addidit.

source: 007 knew that Hidden Blade might have joined a secret organization and understood her predicament. He took a couple of deep breaths to calm himself.
target: 007 sciit Lamina Occulta fortasse societati secretae se adiunxisse atque eius condicionem intellexisse. Paucos graves spiritus cepit ad se tranquillandum.

source: He mumbled to himself, “You all have found so many traces of another world beneath Trier; I can’t believe the two major churches that have watched over Trier for over a thousand years haven’t discovered anything.
target: Murmuravit sibi: “Vos omnes tot vestigia alterius mundi sub Trier invenistis; incredibile est quod duo ecclesiae maximi momenti, quae Trier per plus quam mille annos custodiunt, nihil detexerint.

source: “When I become a demigod, a senior deacon, maybe I’ll be allowed to look at those dossiers, right?”
target: “Cum demideus fiam, senior diaconus, fortasse mihi documenta illa inspicienda licebit, nonne?”

source: “Mmm, mmm,” Franca agreed repeatedly.
target: “Mmm, mmm,” Franca iterumque assensit.

source: In the corner where the Academy group gathered, Professor, Associate Professor, Principal, Isotope and others had all viewed Franca’s portrait of Harrison posted on the stone chair and were eagerly discussing related matters.
target: In angulo, ubi coetus Academiae congregatus est, Professor, Professor Associatus, Principal, Isotope et alii omnes picturam Harrisonis a Franca in sella lapideae positam viderunt et ardenter de rebus pertinentibus disputabant.

source: A woman with the periodic table painted on her face in washable paints asked those around her, “If we really find a way and a path back to our world, would you want to return?”
target: Femina, cui facies tabula periodica in pigmentis lavabilibus picta erat, ab iis circum ea quaesivit: “Si vere viam atque iter ad mundum nostrum reperiamus, redire velitisne?”

source: Professor and Associate Professor looked at each other and said, “If we can bring our children without having to leave anyone behind, we definitely hope to go back.”
target: Professor et Professor Associatus se invicem respexerunt et dixerunt: “Si liberos nostros, sine aliquem relinquendo, adducere possimus, certissime redire speramus.”

source: Principal, suspected of being a Sanguine, laughed.
target: Principal, qui sanguine suspicabatur, risit.

source: “If I could keep my Beyonder abilities, then I’d be willing to go back.”
target: “Si facultates Beyonder meas retinere possem, redire paratus essem.”

source: Isotope, with fake heads on each shoulder and wearing a mannequin headgear, chuckled.
target: Isotope, cum ficta capita in singulis umeris atque galea manichina induta, subridens risit.

source: “I have no attachments or affairs that a mere modern life could replace with the sense of accomplishment I’ve gained in this world; I don’t want to go back.”
target: “Nihil mihi sunt vincula aut negotia, quae sola vita moderna, cum sensu perficiendi quem in hoc mundo adeptus sum, reponere possit; redire non volo.”

source: “What about you, Muggle?” asked Periodic Table, turning to the quietly listening Lumian.
target: “Quid de te, Muggle?” quaesivit Tabula Periodica, ad Luminum quiete auscultantem convertens.

source: Lumian paused for a moment and said in the voice of Aurore, “That’s the place I long for day and night.
target: Lumian paucos momentos stetit et, voce Aurore, dixit: “Illic est locus, quem die ac nocte vehementer desidero.

source: “But I’d also like to take some people who are close to me with me.”
target: “Sed etiam velim aliquos, qui mihi cari sint, mecum ducere.”

source: After much discussion, the topics of “going home” and “Resurrection Island” finally cooled down, and as everyone naturally fell silent, Lumian lifted his beautifully curved chin and looked around, asking, “Does anyone know someone from the Moses Ascetic Order?”
target: Post longam disputationem, argumenta “domum redire” et “Insula Resurrectionis” demum quieta sunt, et cum omnes naturaliter sileverunt, Lumian pulchre incurvato maxillo levavit atque circumspiciens rogavit: “Scit aliquis quemdam ex Ordine Asceticorum Moysium?”

source: Suddenly, most members of the Academy group turned their gaze toward Muggle, observing her rosy lips and pale skin exposed outside her hoodie.
target: Subito, plerique ex membris coetus Academiae oculos converterunt ad Muggle, animadvertentes labra eius rosea et cutem pallidam extra indumentum capuccinum.

source: “Why are you asking this all of a sudden?” asked Professor wearing a butterfly bow tie.
target: “Cur hoc subito interrogas?” rogavit Professor, ligamen papilionis gerens.

source: The Academy group had many Warlocks and had exchanged information about the Moses Ascetic Order, so it wasn’t surprising that “Muggle” knew about this secret organization.
target: Coetus Academiae multos warlockos habebat et informationes de Ordine Asceticorum Moysium commutaverat, itaque non mirum erat quod “Muggle” de hac societate secreta notum haberet.

source: Lumian responded with a smile, “I want to pass a message to the Moses Ascetic Order that there’s a traitor among them.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Volo nuntium ad Ordinem Asceticorum Moysium transmittere: inter eos proditor est.”

source: “A traitor?” Isotope and company listened, somewhat bewildered.
target: “Proditor?” Isotope et ceteri audiverunt, aliquantulum attoniti.

source: Without giving a direct response, Lumian said, “Have you heard of ‘Mirror People’?”
target: Sine responsu directo, Lumian dixit: “Audivistisne de Populo Specularum?”

source: According to Madame Hela’s latest statement, the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society who could enter the Nation of the Evernight through the spell were at most mentally disrupted or harbored corruption inside; it was unlikely that their life forms had changed without detection, so it could preliminarily be ruled out that there were any Mirror People lurking here.
target: Secundum novissimam declarationem Dominae Helae, membra Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis, quae per incantationem in Nationem Perpetuae Noctis ingredi poterant, aut perturbata mente maximi gradus erant aut corruptione interna affecta; minus verisimile erat ut formae vitae eorum sine detectione mutatae essent, itaque initialiter excludi posset ut ulli Populi Specularum hic latearent.

source: “I’ve heard of it,” said Professor in a black half-face mask, nodding solemnly. “There have been occasional incidents of original hosts being replaced by their Mirror People, but why these Mirror People appear is still unknown, and perhaps the official Beyonders have the relevant information.”
target: “Eum audivi,” inquit Professor, in masca nigra semi-faciali indutus, caput solemni animo inclinans. “Occasionalia casus sunt, in quibus hospes originalis a Populo Specularum substituitur; sed cur hi Populi Specularum apparere possint adhuc ignotum est, fortasseque Beyonderi officiales informationem pertinentem habent.”

source: You seem to know quite a bit about the mystical world… Lumian’s lips curled up with a smile.
target: Videtur te multa de mundo mystico scire… Labia Lumiani subridens convoluta erant.

source: “I know a Mirror Person named Griffith who has replaced his original host, and his host was a member of the Moses Ascetic Order; of course, Griffith certainly isn’t the name he used in the Moses Ascetic Order.”
target: “Scio personam specularum, Griffith nomine, qui hospitem suum originalem substituit, et cuius hospes membrum Ordine Asceticorum Moysium fuit; scilicet, Griffith certe non est nomen quod ille in Ordine Asceticorum Moysium usus est.”

source: Members of the “Academy” group remained silent, simply nodding their heads.
target: Membra coetus “Academiae” silentia retinuerunt, capita simpliciter inclinantes.

source: Lumian did not continue the topic.
target: Lumian rem non prosecutus est.

source: Professor looked at her and ventured to ask, “Muggle, are you still in Trier?”
target: Professor eam respexit et audenter rogavit: “Muggle, adhuc in Trier es?”

source: “Yes,” Lumian responded with a smile.
target: “Ita,” Lumian subridens respondit.

source: Professor looked around and said, “I'm planning to organize a real‐world gathering for members in Trier soon; do you want to join? It will primarily involve our Academy group.”
target: Professor circumspiciens dixerit: “Mox conventus realis pro membris in Trier constituendus mihi existimat; velisne te adiungere? Principiter coetum nostram Academiae involvet.”

source: Lumian’s eyes flickered, and he smiled coyly. “Okay.”
target: Oculi Lumiani micaverunt, et ille subridens respondit: “Okay.”
